verdict.rationale: Cekura's observability evidence centers on capturing call-level logs (CallLog with transcript, recording, metadata) and LiveKit SDK tracing, plus dashboards and PII redaction, but nothing in the evidence describes a hierarchical trace model with nested spans grouped into sessions or threads for multi-step agent runs. Missing for 10: explicit span/trace data model, parent-child span nesting, and session/thread grouping documentation.
